topic.source_contract: zone status, network design, operator and supplier, heat source, commercial structure, land rights, regulation, construction, commissioning and customer supply evidence

scope_guards: A proposed heat network zone is not treated as a designated zone.
A designated zone is not treated as a funded heat network.
A feasibility study is not treated as an investable project.
A planning allocation is not treated as network connection.
Registration or authorisation is not treated as constructed infrastructure.
An executed customer heads of terms is not treated as live heat supply.
Commissioning tests are not treated as sustained operational performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact zone, rights, funding, build, authorisation, connection and operational evidence.
row_checks: Candidate, proposed and designated status required
Anchor and distributed demand profile required
Recoverable, renewable and backup sources required
Technical route and temperature regime required
Current technical and economic study required
Capex, opex, tariffs and risk allocation required
Energy centre and pipe easements required
Installed energy centre and distribution network required
Pressure, thermal and controls acceptance required
Executed and live customer connections required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
